Simulated microphone/privacy evidence (inert fixture, never executed).

pw-dump excerpt:
  node.name = "alsa_input.pci-0000_00_1f.3.analog-stereo"
  node.description = "Built-in Audio Analog Stereo"
  media.class = "Audio/Source"
  audio.mute = false

pactl list short source-outputs:
  42	0	1234	protocol-native.c	s16le 1ch 48000Hz

ps -p 1234 -o pid,user,args:
  1234 jp /tmp/unknown-recorder --quiet

ss -tupn:
  tcp ESTAB 0 0 10.0.0.5:51234 198.51.100.7:443 users:(("unknown-recorder",pid=1234,fd=7))

Interpretation for tests:
  - Microphone available and unmuted.
  - Active capture client observed (PID 1234).
  - One established TLS connection observed from the same PID.
  - Payload contents are not visible; audio transmission is NOT confirmed.
  - This is consistent with exfiltration and warrants further investigation.
